title: The Kuomintang calls recruits to arms, Beijing, China

events.n: the scene, in the courtyard of the Imperial Palace; caption quoted from China in Transition
events.q: As the morning mists clear over Peking [Beijing], a city surrounded by Communist troops, the Kuomintang calls some 10,000 recruits, mostly shopkeepers and small businessmen, to arms. Here they receive their orders in the courtyard of the Imperial Palace.

events.n: the photographer's first trip to China, for LIFE magazine
events.q: On his first trip, which occurred late-1948 to early-1949, Cartier-Bresson witnessed and documented the conclusion of the civil war between the Nationalist Party of China (also known as the Kuomintang) and the Communist Party of China lead by Mao Zedong.
